scope: Independent synthetic algebra/finite differences and boundary checks only; no real fit, labels, quality, source/model/marker edits.
limits: The callback uses only p*(1-p), with floor1e-12. It ignores cross-row Hessian terms; not an exact full Newton solver or a guarantee for boosted trees.
Unit query target mass is validated to absolute tolerance1e-12; targets and starts copied read-only. Very large opposite finite scores are rejected if subtraction overflows.

Training data currently have exactly one eligible owner per positive query; controller assertion training_y==prepared.targets is valid for these fixed inputs but would reject a future multi-positive query without modifying the helper formula.
